Package org.codehaus.mojo.jaxb2.javageneration

Class EpisodeArtifact

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.codehaus.mojo.jaxb2.javageneration.EpisodeArtifact
  • public class EpisodeArtifact
extends Object

    Configuration model for a Maven artifact containing a JAXB episode file, to be used as an external binding by XJC when compiling another schema. Declared within the episodes parameter of the xjc goal:

         
         <episodes>
             <episode>
                 <groupId>com.acme.schemas</groupId>
                 <artifactId>schema-a</artifactId>
                 <version>1.4.0</version>
                 <!-- optional elements: -->
                 <type>jar</type>
                 <classifier></classifier>
                 <resourcePath>META-INF/sun-jaxb.episode</resourcePath>
                 <optional>false</optional>
             </episode>
         </episodes>
    Since:
    4.1.1
    See Also:
    XjcMojo.episodes

      • getResourcePath

        public String getResourcePath()

        An explicit path to the episode resource within the artifact, relative to its root (e.g. META-INF/sun-jaxb.episode). When omitted, the plugin discovers the episode using its standard search order and fails if the result is ambiguous.

        Returns:
        The explicit episode resource path within the artifact, or null for auto-discovery.
